intent.subtype: addition carried in a wider intermediate
intent.rationale: Both operands are zero-extended to 9 bits before the add and the average takes bits [8:1], so the carry is kept.

labels.note: Sum is formed in 9 bits and the upper 8 bits are taken explicitly.
The 9-bit sum keeps the carry and [8:1] is the full-precision average.
